scopeNotes: 434 existing walking-world NPC placements; 10 tribe specialist concepts are a separate catalogue and not delivered five tribal hubs.
Source V72 roles have exactly one idle cell each and V74 role-only walking clips.
Use regionId + localId for 120 regional core identities because local IDs repeat across regions.
Do not duplicate quest/service actors: 20 visual variants are libraries, not 20 quest givers at each point.
Preserve authored names, greeted IDs, roles, routes, collision footprints and save formats.
Avoid morphId-derived profession reassignment; age and body type do not change the job.
Stable appearance must not reroll on movement, UI redraw, loading, entry or save restore.
